fullDescription: A high-fidelity industrial design system based on Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO) hardware interfaces. Characterized by deep dark-mode neumorphism, skeuomorphic rotary controls, and simulated CRT/LCD displays. It features a tactical, tactile aesthetic using teal and amber accents against a slate-charcoal palette. Perfect for engineering firms, embedded systems providers, high-tech manufacturing, fintech dashboards, or specialized SaaS products requiring a rugged, technical, and precise visual identity.
prompt:
## Resumo
A retro-modern industrial hardware interface featuring a dark charcoal neumorphic chassis, an animated LCD service matrix, tactical rotary encoders with haptic feedback, and glowing LED status indicators.

## Estilo Visual
Create a dark industrial UI style based on a Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO). 

### Colors
- Background: #1e2229
- Panel Surface: #272d36
- Inset Bezels: #2a3039
- LCD Background: #141920
- Primary Accent: Teal (#38b2ac) with glow (#38b2ac66)
- Secondary Accent: Amber (#d4a052) with glow (#d4a05266)
- Text: Bright Gray (#e8ecf1), Muted Blue-Gray (#6b7a8d)

### Neumorphic Effects
- Standard Shadow: 6px 6px 14px rgba(10, 12, 16, 0.65), -6px -6px 14px rgba(55, 63, 75, 0.35)
- Inset Shadow: inset 4px 4px 10px rgba(10, 12, 16, 0.6), inset -4px -4px 10px rgba(55, 63, 75, 0.25)
- Deep Inset (for bezels): inset 6px 6px 14px rgba(10, 12, 16, 0.7), inset -6px -6px 14px rgba(55, 63, 75, 0.2)

### Typography
- Display: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', weights 700-900 for hero text.
- Technical: 'DM Sans', weight 400-500, font-size: 9px, letter-spacing: 2.5px, uppercase for labels.

### Animations
- CRT Scanline: A 2px horizontal gradient sweeping vertically across LCD sections (4s linear loop).
- Haptic Snap: CSS transform shakes (rotation/translation) triggered during state changes (0.04s steps).
- Breathing Glow: Radial gradient opacity cycling from 0 to 0.08 over 3s.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Brand Strips (Header/Footer)
Horizontal bars with gradient background linear-gradient(90deg, #272d36, #313842, #272d36). Include small 6px pulsing status dots (Teal), 'screw head' icons in corners (12px circles with inset shadows and a center slot line), and uppercase labels with 3px letter spacing.

### Hero Section (Top-Left)
A bezel-inset panel containing a large display heading. Use clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.75rem) for font size. Include a 'vent grille' decorative element at the bottom (multiple 24x2px lines with inset shadows). Add absolute-positioned screw icons in the top corners.

### Service Matrix LCD (Top-Right)
A screen with an background of #141920. Overlay a 20px graticule dot grid. Split the screen into a 2x2 grid using 1px lines of rgba(56, 178, 172, 0.12). Cells should have a hover state of rgba(56, 178, 172, 0.06). Active cells display glowing teal icons and labels.

### Tactical Controls (Bottom-Left)
Feature two types of buttons. Primary: Linear gradient (#3a9e98 to #2d8a84) with a white glow. Secondary: Standard panel-bg with neumorphic shadows. Below buttons, display a horizontal row of stats with bold headers and muted subtext.

### Rotary Selector (Bottom-Right)
A 200px circular assembly. Around the circle, place 4 LED indicators (10px circles) and 4 abbreviated labels (HW, PCB, FW, 3D). The center features a 110px rotary knob with a finger indent and a vertical indicator line. Rotating the knob triggers the active state for the corresponding LED and LCD cell.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Rotary Knob — A skeuomorphic 3D knob that rotates to select states.
The knob body is a 110px circle with a gradient from #4a5260 to #353c47. It features a finger indent (#2e343d with deep inset shadows) and a top-aligned indicator line. Implement dragging logic where vertical movement or angular mouse movement rotates the knob. On snap-to-position (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees), trigger a micro-shake animation using GSAP (x: 1.5, repeat: 3, duration: 0.04s) to simulate physical haptics.

### Glow LEDs — Hardware-style status indicators with simulated light emission.
10px circular elements. 'Off' state: #2a2f38 with inset shadow. 'Active' state (Teal): background #38b2ac, box-shadow: 0 0 8px #38b2ac66, 0 0 20px #38b2ac33. When activated, the LED should pulse scale (1.4x) briefly.

### Neumorphic Press Button — Tactile button that visually depresses into the surface.
On mousedown/active, transition from box-shadow: var(--neo-shadow) to box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 10px rgba(10, 12, 16, 0.6). Apply a slight transform: translateY(1px) and scale(0.98) to simulate mechanical travel.

structured.summary: A retro-modern industrial hardware interface featuring a dark charcoal neumorphic chassis, an animated LCD service matrix, tactical rotary encoders with haptic feedback, and glowing LED status indicators.

style.description: The style combines dark neumorphism with industrial skeuomorphism. Typography uses 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for bold headings and 'DM Sans' for technical labels. Color palette centers on deep slates (#1e2229, #272d36) with high-contrast teal (#38b2ac) and amber (#d4a052) functional highlights. Animations include scanline sweeps, breathing glows, and haptic-simulated 'snaps' for physical controls.
